description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of an item management interface for TodoItems. It provides methods to add and update TodoItems stored in a thread-safe list, with synchronized blocks for thread safety.

classes.name: TodoItemManagementInMemory
classes.description: In-memory implementation of ItemManagement for TodoItems that supports adding and updating items with thread safety.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Returns the list of current TodoItems.

methods.name: setTodoItems
methods.description: Sets the internal list of TodoItems.

methods.name: addTodoItem
methods.description: Adds a new TodoItem to the list, assigning it a unique id based on the last item's id.

methods.name: updateTodoItem
methods.description: Marks provided TodoItems as complete and updates them in the list within synchronized blocks.
